## Mod Link
Please provide a [**Modrinth**](https://modrinth.com/) project and [**Github**](https://github.com/) repository URL for the mod you are proposing integration with.

## Description
Please describe to the best of your ability how you propose integration with this mod would be best implemented.

### Screenshots (if applicable)
Attach screenshots if needed to illustrate your concept.
